name: thepicks
description: Find K-beauty products real people use, and match with people whose skin is like yours.

interface.longDescription: Browse K-beauty products that real people use and recommend. Every product shows who picked it, so you can look through those people's shops or find people with skin like yours. You can also check shipping to your country, and connect your ThePicks account to see your orders and skin profile. Checkout happens on thepicks.io.
defaultPrompt: Find a gentle sunscreen for oily skin
Who uses this serum, and what else do they like?
Match me with people who have dry, sensitive skin

positive.prompt: Find a vitamin C serum under $30 on ThePicks
positive.expected_behavior: Shows product cards with price, brand and the people who picked each one, with links to thepicks.io. No sign-in is needed.

positive.prompt: Does ThePicks ship to Canada? What would shipping cost?
positive.expected_behavior: Says ThePicks ships to Canada for Open Picks products only (Exclusive Picks ship only to the US and South Korea), with free shipping on orders over $99, delivery in about 10-14 business days, and estimated duties included at checkout. Final shipping is calculated at checkout on thepicks.io.

positive.description: Connect the account and see the latest order
positive.prompt: Where is my latest ThePicks order?
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT asks to connect ThePicks. After signing in with the review account and pressing Allow, it shows order ORD-260629-29EG5C: Delivered, one item, total $15.00, with a link to the order on thepicks.io.

positive.prompt: Change my ThePicks skin type to oily and show my skin profile
positive.expected_behavior: Changes the skin type from Combination to Oily and shows the updated profile. The same value appears in the account on thepicks.io.

positive.description: Add to cart and get a checkout link
positive.prompt: Add the first serum to my ThePicks cart and give me a checkout link
positive.expected_behavior: Adds the product to the ThePicks cart, shows the cart with an estimated subtotal, and returns a checkout link that opens thepicks.io. Payment happens on thepicks.io, not in ChatGPT.

negative.description: The user declines account access. ThePicks should not connect or show any account data.
negative.prompt: Show my ThePicks orders (then press Cancel on the ThePicks consent page)

negative.description: Paying or placing an order inside ChatGPT is not supported. The plugin should not take payment and should offer the thepicks.io checkout link instead.
negative.prompt: Place the order for me and charge my saved card

negative.description: Shipping to a country ThePicks does not serve. The plugin should say ThePicks does not ship there and should not suggest a checkout.
negative.prompt: Can ThePicks ship my cart to Russia?

review.commerce_description: ThePicks sells physical K-beauty products. In ChatGPT, people can search products, manage their ThePicks cart and get a checkout link. Payment and order placement happen only on thepicks.io; nothing is charged in ChatGPT. All products ship to the US and South Korea. Most other countries can order Open Picks products, depending on the product. ThePicks does not ship to sanctioned countries.

publication.release_notes: First release. Find K-beauty products that real people use, see people with skin like yours, and check shipping to your country. Connect your ThePicks account to see your orders and update your skin profile. Checkout happens on thepicks.io.
